offer: Web Topup + Bot WhatsApp; duration only

scenes.title: Pembuka
scenes.headline: Web + Bot. Satu paket.
scenes.visual: Opening hero for the NEW SINGLE-BUNDLE offer. One elegant laptop storefront and one WhatsApp smartphone side by side joined as ONE unified product by a smooth cyan loop, on the same soft white indigo studio pedestal. Original DigitalToko logo above. Large headline exactly 'Web + Bot. Satu paket.'. Small subtitle exactly 'Web Topup + Bot WhatsApp'. No separate pricing tiers or separate web/bot choice. Minimal clean original digital product icons, no physical merchandise.
scenes.vo: Sekarang, satu paket untuk web topup dan bot WhatsApp. Kenalkan, Digital Toko.
scenes.motion: Slow cinematic push-in. Laptop and smartphone rise gently into view, a cyan ribbon connects the web storefront and chat. A soft light sweep passes over the DigitalToko logo. Keep headline and UI text stable. Hold clearly for one second at the end.

scenes.title: Daftar & pilih paket
scenes.headline: Bedanya cuma durasi.
scenes.visual: Registration and subscription keyframe for ONE SINGLE PACKAGE, no platform selection. A clean digital dashboard with an onboarding stepper 'Daftar', 'Verifikasi', 'Buat toko', 'Pilih durasi'. ONE large bundle card labeled exactly 'Web Topup + Bot WhatsApp'. Within the same single card two included checkmarks read 'Web toko' and 'Bot WhatsApp'. Under them one collapsed duration dropdown labeled 'Pilih durasi sewa' and one indigo button 'Lanjutkan'. A store identity area says 'Nama toko' and 'Subdomain'. Do not show separate Web, Bot or Combo price cards. No numeric prices, no annual savings claims. Main headline exactly 'Bedanya cuma durasi.'.
scenes.vo: Daftar, lengkapi verifikasi, lalu buat toko. Web Topup dan Bot WhatsApp sudah termasuk. Tinggal pilih durasi sewanya.
scenes.motion: Slow dolly toward the single bundle panel. Illuminate Daftar, Verifikasi, Buat toko and Pilih durasi in order. Highlight both included web and WhatsApp checkmarks together. Gently pulse the duration dropdown then Lanjutkan once. Never create platform tabs or a separate Bot-only/Web-only choice.

scenes.title: Hubungkan pemasok
scenes.headline: Semua sumber, satu katalog.
scenes.visual: A central beautiful catalog dashboard with product cards and small generic icons for pulsa, paket data, games and premium apps. Three external supplier connector tiles labeled exactly 'Digiflazz', 'API Hanshop', 'OtomaX' connect into this dashboard using thin curved cyan paths. A fourth tile 'Stok premium' joins the catalog. A discreet UI control labeled 'Atur markup', no invented prices. Large headline exactly 'Semua sumber, satu katalog.'. The logo and overall style match the first reference.
scenes.vo: Hubungkan Digiflazz, Hanshop, atau pemasok OtomaX. Impor katalog, atur markup harga, dan kelola stok aplikasi premium.
scenes.motion: Three supplier tiles softly illuminate, cyan pulses travel toward the central catalog, then product rows populate once. Briefly highlight Atur markup and Stok premium. Restrained camera orbit under three degrees, no shaking.

scenes.title: Custom tampilan toko
scenes.headline: Desain sesuai brand Anda.
scenes.visual: An elegant website design editor floating above a white rounded pedestal. Side panel with three template thumbnail cards labeled 'Nebula', 'Aurora', 'Atlas', a row of indigo cyan and pastel color swatches, logo upload icon, banner thumbnail and reorder handle icons. Main preview shows an attractive digital store mobile homepage with banner and product categories. Large headline exactly 'Desain sesuai brand Anda.'. Small label 'Template • Warna • Logo • Banner'. The mock editor is illustrative and clean rather than microscopic.
scenes.vo: Pilih template, ganti warna, logo, dan banner. Susun beranda sesuai brand, lalu siapkan domain toko milikmu.
scenes.motion: Cursor selects Aurora, then a cyan swatch. The storefront preview smoothly switches palette, one banner slides in, and two homepage sections gently reorder. End with the completed storefront preview enlarged slightly. Keep all existing text stable.

scenes.title: Panduan bergambar
scenes.headline: Ada panduan di setiap langkah.
scenes.visual: An open DigitalToko help center on a large vertical-friendly floating browser card. Top label 'Panduan'. Three large readable illustrated step cards numbered 1, 2, 3 with simple diagram screenshot thumbnails, indigo click markers and one cyan arrow each. Sidebar topic chips 'Pemasok', 'Pembayaran', 'WhatsApp'. Hero headline exactly 'Ada panduan di setiap langkah.'. A small 'Panduan' button visually connects from a mini admin panel to the help page. No walls of text, no invented technical data.
scenes.vo: Butuh bantuan? Ikuti panduan bergambar, dari koneksi pemasok, pembayaran, hingga pengaturan toko. Langkahnya bisa kamu ikuti dari panel.
scenes.motion: Start by highlighting the small Panduan button. The guide opens with a soft card expansion; camera pans slowly across steps 1, 2, 3. Click markers pulse once each. No scrolling through unreadable text.

scenes.title: Pelanggan memesan
scenes.headline: Pilih. Bayar. Pantau.
scenes.visual: One premium smartphone in front of a matching digital storefront display. A clean checkout UI with three stacked steps labeled exactly 'Pilih produk', 'Isi tujuan', 'Bayar', then a green verified status tile 'Pembayaran diterima' and a subtle order tracking card. A separate small generic WhatsApp-style bubble says 'Pesanan diproses'. No scannable QR or payment credentials. Products are generic data topup cards; show a fake destination field as bullet dots only. Large headline exactly 'Pilih. Bayar. Pantau.'.
scenes.vo: Toko aktif, pelanggan pilih produk, isi tujuan, lalu bayar. Pesanan diproses dan statusnya dipantau lewat web atau WhatsApp.
scenes.motion: Soft cursor chooses a data product, destination field fills with masked dots, then payment confirmation transitions to order processing. A WhatsApp notification gently slides up. Show a natural pending processing stage; do not imply every supplier always succeeds instantly.

scenes.title: Operasional lebih mudah
scenes.headline: Kelola usaha, lebih terarah.
scenes.visual: A beautifully organized DigitalToko owner dashboard as central floating tablet, four compact feature cards around it labeled 'Transaksi', 'Saldo pelanggan', 'Voucher', 'Staff'. Restrained tiny line chart with no numeric profit claims, transaction list with neutral status dots, one voucher ticket icon, and team permission avatars as generic symbols not real people. Large headline exactly 'Kelola usaha, lebih terarah.'. White indigo cyan studio 3D style consistent.
scenes.vo: Pantau transaksi, kelola saldo pelanggan, buat voucher, dan bagi tugas bersama staff dalam satu panel.
scenes.motion: A smooth lateral camera move reveals the four feature cards one at a time, then they align neatly around the dashboard. Highlight transaction status and a voucher ticket, no rapid blinking.

scenes.title: Ajakan mulai
scenes.headline: Satu paket. Dua cara jualan.
scenes.visual: Final CTA brand keyframe for ONE SINGLE PACKAGE. Original DigitalToko logo large and sharp in upper safe area. Elegant laptop storefront and WhatsApp smartphone together on a matching white indigo cyan pedestal, joined by a cyan loop. Large headline exactly 'Satu paket. Dua cara jualan.'. One benefit line exactly 'Web Topup + Bot WhatsApp'. Single prominent CTA exactly 'Pilih durasi & mulai'. No separate platform options, three tiers, numeric prices, dates, free trial, URL or money claims. Generic digital topup icons only, no physical goods for sale. Holdable clean composition.
scenes.vo: Satu paket, dua cara berjualan. Pilih durasi, bangun toko digital dengan brand sendiri, dan mulai bersama Digital Toko.
scenes.motion: Bring laptop and phone into a calm balanced arrangement. Very slow push-in toward the logo and CTA, a single subtle cyan shimmer through the ribbon, hold the CTA clearly for the last three seconds. Finish in a clean stable frame.
